PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: Role-based access control for Celestial CMS.
PERM_ROLES_READ_DESC: Allow listing roles and role details.
PERM_ROLES_WRITE_DESC: Allow creating, updating, and deleting roles.
PERM_USERS_ASSIGN_DESC: Allow assigning and revoking user roles.
CONFIG_ENFORCEMENT_DESC: Enable RBAC permission checks when true.
CONFIG_BOOTSTRAP_DESC: Allow one-time admin bootstrap when no admin exists.
